title: Trust answered with deception
odia:
ଆଶା କରିଥିଲି ତୋତେ
କାଉକୁ ଯେମନ୍ତ କୋଇଲି ଭଣ୍ଡାଏ
ସେହିପରି କର ମୋତେ।
literal_meaning: I had placed my hopes in you. As the koel deceives the crow, so you treat me.
meaning_odia: ଯାହା ଉପରେ ଆଶା ରଖାଯାଇଥିଲା, ସେହି ଲୋକ ଭଣ୍ଡାଉଛି ବୋଲି କଥକର ଅଭିଯୋଗ। କାଉକୁ କୋଇଲି ଭଣ୍ଡାଇବାର ତୁଳନାରେ ସେ ନିଜ ହତାଶା ପ୍ରକାଶ କରୁଛି।
explanation: The first line declares trust; the next two answer it with an accusation of deception. The speaker casts themself as the crow and the trusted person as the koel. This edition reads the verse as a complaint that reliance on someone has been repaid with trickery.
usage_example: A person relies on a promised favour and later discovers that the promise was only a way to mislead them. These lines could voice their disappointment. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The comparison gives the crow the speaker’s place and the koel the trusted person’s place. Its force comes from being deceived by someone on whom the speaker had relied.
